text: {"lessons":["A short-term decline does not by itself justify selling; my account recovered after its Period 3 dip, so I should assess the broader picture calmly.","I sold Stocks A and E at losses; I should reassess each holding's risks and reasons for owning it rather than let my average cost or a momentary reaction dictate a trade.","My account has had modest ups and downs while I mostly held steady; given my retirement needs and preference to avoid large swings, I should trade deliberately and keep risk within my comfort level."]}
